limitations: All 238 names/candidates in the initial 2026-09-30 snapshot were reviewed for scope; this is not every real-world entertainment business. Unknown closures, absent tags and new openings may remain.
The rectangle includes western Abbotsford and parts of Bowen Island, and excludes places beyond its edges. Source city/address blanks are preserved; no municipality is guessed from coordinates.

Categories describe primary venue use, not every activity. Concert-capable live theatres remain Theatre unless a reviewed concert use is primary. Bars/nightclubs are not included merely for drinks or dancing; dedicated live-music venues have source evidence.
Arcades include mapped video, VR, claw-machine and family game venues. Golf simulators, pool-only halls, incidental pub games, unnamed park arcades and individual amusement rides are excluded.

Family attractions are limited to named source-supported zoo/aquarium/theme or destination water parks; generic tourist sights, museums, high-ropes courses, individual animal enclosures and neighbourhood splash pads are excluded.
Seasonal parks remain destinations and may be closed outside their operating season. Admission, bookings, tickets and age restrictions vary; no opening-hours or availability guarantee is made.

Massey Theatre remains mapped as a permanent venue with an explicit July–November 2026 temporary-closure note; recheck its reopening and remove the note only after verification. Rialto closure is based on an owner interview reported by Global, not a surviving operator notice. Hollywood 3 Surrey and Pitt Meadows were not returned and are not supplemented.

Official reviews and manual identity merges retain their original review date when OSM is refreshed. Recheck renamed venues, closures, scope overrides and merge pairs as part of a later publication review.

Coordinates are unchanged OSM node points or feature bounding-box centres, not surveyed entrances. No supplementary coordinates are invented; building-centre points may be approximate for indoor stages.
refresh_policy: One bounded request and no automatic retries. Partial responses, query mismatch, missing geometry/timestamps, duplicates and anomalous counts fail before publication.
